audit.whatIsWrong: First-item and 2+ item rows read 'Poppy' in both layers while packet.levelChart says Skill then Vladimir, and whys[5]/whys[6] say 'even' and 'he out-scales hard'.
audit.why: The rendered chart claimed Poppy wins the late game directly beside a why paragraph saying she loses it.
audit.corrected: Rows 5 and 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs with ratings updated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and 2-item whys were generic 'your pattern is at full power' text that contradicted the actual spike ownership.
audit.why: Poppy's Iceborn Gauntlet lands before Rylai's/Liandry's — that is the even window; after them Vladimir owns it.
audit.corrected: Both whys now name the item spikes that decide each row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool's 2-second untargetability and its 28/25/22/19/16s cooldown were never stated; trade lines used a placeholder 'his answer'. Crimson Pact was never mentioned despite the 'Build MR' and 'Stack pure HP' entries depending on it.
audit.why: Pool makes Vladimir untargetable for 2s, which voids Poppy's E stun, her Q zone detonation and her R channel payoff. Crimson Pact converts bonus health into AP and AP into health, so HP stacking against him is worse than resistances.
audit.corrected: Pool's duration and cooldown now stated, and the MR/HP advice now cites Crimson Pact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned only in the itemization line, not in the trading guidance.
audit.why: Transfusion is a 0-cost heal on a 9s-to-4.6s cooldown and Hemoplague heals per champion hit, so any grind trade loses without Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Mid-game trading guidance now names Grievous Wounds timing.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Sanguine Pool's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet lands before Rylai's — an even window, so force short trades while Pool is on cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Vladimir carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He out-scales: Rylai's and Liandry's kite your flat damage and Pool dodges every engage. Frontline and peel, and keep anti-heal on him.

edits.before: E Vladimir into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E him into a wall while Sanguine Pool (28s at rank 1) is down, Q the zone under him, and walk off before Transfusion heals it back.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: E-ing while Pool is up — he turns untargetable for 2 seconds and your entire commit whiffs.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Sanguine Pool: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around Sanguine Pool: with it down run the full pattern, with it up give nothing. Buy Grievous Wounds early — Transfusion out-heals chip damage.

edits.before: Dodges your combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Pool is 28s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5. Fake a step-in, then commit.

edits.before: E Vladimir into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: Crimson Pact turns his AP into health and back, so he is never squishy — Mercury's Treads and Frozen Heart beat raw HP into his poke.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Pool spent — E him into terrain and Q under him before Transfusion heals.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Pool is 2 seconds of untargetability — it eats your E, your Q explosion and your R.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crimson Pact scales his AP off health too — buy MR, not more raw HP.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: After Rylai's and Liandry's he kites your flat damage and pools out of every engage.

edits.before: Track Vladimir's Sanguine Pool: Dodges your combo. Bait it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool gives 2s of untargetability — it dodges E, Q and R. Bait it, then E-Q + R.

notes: Rows 5 and 6 of the level chart contradicted packet.levelChart and their own whys in both layers; flipped as one paired group.
